Astrology

Astrology is the language of the cosmos — a map written in the stars at the moment of your birth that speaks to your strengths, challenges, purpose, and timing. Whether you're seeking insight into your relationships, career, spiritual path, or the season you're in — your birth chart holds the answers.

Birth / Natal Chart Reading

A deep-dive into your complete cosmic blueprint. We'll explore your Sun, Moon, rising sign, planetary placements, aspects, and more. This is the foundational reading — 90 minutes.

$120 / 90 min

Transit Report

What are the planets doing right now, and how are they affecting you specifically? A transit report looks at current planetary movements and their meaning for your chart.

$80 / 60 min

Solar Return

Your birthday marks when the Sun returns to its exact position at your birth. A solar return reading gives you the themes and opportunities for the year ahead.

$90 / 60 min

Monthly Horoscope

A written horoscope for your zodiac sign — published monthly. Covers key themes, dates to watch, and cosmic guidance for the month ahead.

Free on the blog

Mediumship

As a medium, I serve as a bridge between this world and the next. If you've lost someone you love and long to know they're at peace — or that they have a message for you — I can help open that connection. My approach is gentle, compassionate, and focused on love, not drama.

I don't do cold readings or make general statements. What comes through is specific, personal, and meant for you.

Private Mediumship Reading

One-on-one session to connect with your loved one. Evidence of survival, messages of love, and any guidance they have for you. 60 minutes.

$130 / 60 min

Mediumship Gallery / Group Session

Open events where multiple people receive readings in a group setting. Each person receives a personal reading in a supportive, shared environment.

$60 / person

Tarot

The tarot is one of humanity's oldest wisdom tools — 78 cards that hold a mirror up to your inner world and illuminate the path forward. Whether you're facing a decision, feeling stuck, or simply seeking direction, the cards offer clarity and guidance.

Single Card Draw

A quick, focused reading around one specific question or situation. Great for daily guidance or when you need a quick yes/no direction.

$30 / 15 min

Three Card Reading

Past, present, future — or situation, obstacle, guidance. A simple but powerful three-card spread for clarity on any topic.

$50 / 30 min

Full Celtic Cross Reading

The classic 10-card spread. A deep, thorough reading exploring the full landscape of your question or situation. The full picture.

$100 / 60 min
